name: Gmail

verdict.topBlocker: The Gmail scopes agents need (readonly, modify, compose) are restricted: ~6-week verification plus a mandatory, paid, annual CASA security assessment.
verdict.summary: Creating the Google Cloud project and testing with up to 100 test users takes about an hour, but test authorizations expire after 7 days. Production access to the Gmail scopes an agent usually needs (gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose) means restricted-scope verification (Google estimates ~6 weeks) plus a mandatory annual CASA security assessment by a paid third-party assessor. gmail.send alone is 'sensitive' (about 10 business days, no CASA).

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud Project & Open Google Auth Platform
steps.detail: Sign into the Google Cloud console, navigate to APIs & Services > Credentials, and ensure billing and the Gmail API are enabled for your project.

steps.title: Draft Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
steps.detail: Generate compliant Privacy Policy and Terms of Service documents detailing how user email data is requested, stored, and used in accordance with Google User Data Policies.

steps.title: Register Authorized Domains & Create OAuth Credentials
steps.detail: Add your verified top domain to Authorized Domains in the Google Cloud Console before configuring authorized redirect URIs (HTTPS required) and generating your Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Configure Consent Screen & Test Scopes
steps.detail: Set up your OAuth consent screen with app details, support email, and requested Gmail scopes (e.g. gmail.readonly or gmail.send). Add test users for sandbox testing.

steps.title: Run PKCE Automated Test OAuth Flow
steps.detail: Execute an automated OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant flow using PKCE verifier/challenge against the authorization endpoint https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth and exchange codes at https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token.

steps.title: Verify Test Account Mailbox Integration
steps.detail: Log in with a designated test Google Account to complete user consent and confirm that Gmail API actions (reading/sending mail) operate properly.

steps.title: Record Scope Demonstration Video
steps.detail: Create a screen recording video demonstrating how a user signs in, authenticates with Google, and how requested Gmail API scopes are utilized in product context.

steps.title: Submit OAuth Verification & Brand Verification
steps.detail: Submit the OAuth consent screen configuration, demo video link, privacy policy, and brand assets for verification in Google Cloud Console.

steps.title: Wait for Google OAuth Verification Review
steps.detail: Brand verification (Google estimates 2–3 business days) must be completed and published first. Then scope verification: about 10 business days for sensitive scopes, about 6 weeks for restricted scopes (estimates from Google's verification FAQ).

steps.title: Complete the CASA security assessment (mandatory for restricted scopes)
steps.detail: Restricted Gmail scopes require a CASA assessment by an independent, Google-authorized assessor, renewed every 12 months. Google charges no fee, but the assessor does; the price isn't published by Google.

requirements.note: Authorized domains must be verified in Google Search Console before configuring redirect URIs or branding links.
Must be hosted on a verified domain and linked identically on the app homepage and OAuth consent screen.
Required for external production applications submitting for brand or OAuth verification.
A mandatory video showing the OAuth flow and explicit scope usage must be submitted during verification.
Required if your application requests restricted Gmail scopes.

scopes.note: RESTRICTED (not sensitive): restricted-scope verification plus annual CASA security assessment. gmail.modify, gmail.compose, gmail.insert, gmail.metadata and the gmail.settings scopes are restricted too.
Sensitive scope: OAuth verification (Google estimates ~10 business days); no CASA assessment.
Full access scope for Gmail; classified as restricted and triggers OAuth verification plus security assessment.
Standard OpenID Connect scope for basic authentication.
Non-sensitive scope for obtaining the user's primary email address.

blockers.symptom: Test users have to reconnect every week.
blockers.cause: In 'Testing' publishing status, test-user authorizations and refresh tokens expire 7 days after consent, and you are limited to 100 test users.
blockers.unblock: Expected during development. Move to 'In production' once verification is underway; unverified production apps show a warning and are capped at 100 new users for the project's lifetime.

blockers.symptom: Authorization request fails with redirect_uri_mismatch error.
blockers.cause: The redirect_uri passed in the authorization request does not exactly match an authorized URI registered on the OAuth client credentials.
blockers.unblock: Add the exact URI (including protocol, host, port, and path) to Authorized Redirect URIs in the Google Cloud Console client configuration.

blockers.symptom: Users encounter an 'Unverified app' warning screen during OAuth sign-in.
blockers.cause: The public application requests sensitive or restricted scopes without having completed Google's OAuth verification process.
blockers.unblock: Submit your application, domain links, privacy policy, and demo video for OAuth verification in Google API Console.

blockers.symptom: Draft app listing cannot be published in Google Workspace Marketplace.
blockers.cause: The project uses unverified sensitive or restricted scopes.
blockers.unblock: Complete OAuth verification for all declared sensitive/restricted scopes before attempting to publish the app listing.

gaps: Exact monetary fee structure for third-party security assessments on restricted scopes is not detailed in the sources.
reviewNote: Difficulty 5 is right, but the guide calls gmail.readonly sensitive and the assessment optional. Google's FAQ estimates 10 business days for sensitive-only (gmail.send) and 6 weeks for restricted, with CASA as the final step that can add time. Preparing CASA evidence, fixing findings and the demo video take more than 4-12 hours.

reviewAdditions.text: Testing publishing status: max 100 test users; test-user authorizations and refresh tokens expire 7 days after consent
Unverified apps show an 'unverified app' screen and are capped at 100 new users over the project's lifetime (cannot be reset)
Three distinct verification tiers: brand (2-3 business days), sensitive (~10 business days), restricted (~6 weeks); brand verification must be published before data-access verification
CASA details: independent Google-approved assessor, Letter of Assessment, reverification at least every 12 months; Google charges no fee but developer pays the assessor directly
Restricted-scope policy requirements: allowed use cases only, Limited Use data rules (no ads, restricted human access/transfers), narrowest-scope justification
Narrower Gmail alternatives: gmail.labels is non-sensitive and gmail.send is only sensitive (avoids CASA)
Demo video must be unlisted on YouTube and show consent screen with app name and client ID in the address bar
Exemptions: internal (Workspace org) apps and personal-use/dev apps don't require verification
Refresh-token limit of 100 per Google Account per client ID; oldest silently invalidated
